ios.desc:
Later: The Intention Setting App

Later is for the things you want to do... later. Stop trying to remember everything or cluttering your to-do list with ideas that aren't urgent. With Later, capture your intentions in a beautiful, distraction-free space.

Why use Later?
• Capture intentions quickly - Save ideas, projects, and tasks you want to get to eventually
• Organize intuitively - Add tags to categorize your intentions and find them easily
• Add context - Include notes and links for reference when you're ready to act
• Set priorities - Mark what matters most to you
• Stay focused - Later keeps your someday/maybe ideas separate from your urgent tasks

Features:
• Beautiful, distraction-free interface
• Simple organization with custom tags
• Link previews for quick reference
• Daily notification reminders
• iCloud sync across all your devices
• Custom tags for perfect organization
• Rich link previews
• Priority levels
• Advanced search and filters
• Intention history

Whether you're capturing project ideas, books to read, places to visit, or things to learn, Later gives you the perfect space to set intentions without the pressure of a traditional to-do list.

Privacy & Terms:
• Privacy Policy: https://ntl.ai/later-privacy-policy/
• Terms of Service: https://ntl.ai/later-terms-of-service/
